none: PAS SUSS-A4379D: A complete Roman struck or hammered copper alloy contemproary copy, nummus demonination, house of Constantine.
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete Roman, struck or hammered copper alloy contemproary copy nummus of the house of Constantine, Reece period 17, AD330-348. Obverse is the bust of illigebile emperor, right. The reverse is badly worn but probably, two soldiers one standard. Legend: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. The coin is 11.66mm in diameter and weighs 0.67 grams
